gloss: to persist in; to insist on; to stick stubbornly to

definitions.gloss: to persist in; to insist on; to stick stubbornly to
definitions.explanation: To refuse to change one's opinion, position, or method despite pressure or reason to do so. Implies stubbornness and inflexibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{固執|こしつ}する。
examples.english: To insist on one's own opinion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{固執|こしつ}して⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's no progress if you cling to the old way of doing things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{固執|こしつ}して、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{聞|き}こう→聞く：00483_kiku⟧としなかった。
examples.english: He stubbornly stuck to his position and refused to listen to anyone.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb meaning to stubbornly persist in or cling to something. Composed of {固|こ} (solid, firm) + {執|しつ} (hold, grasp). Always negative in connotation, implying that the person is unreasonably rigid.

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read こしゅう, though こしつ is more standard in modern usage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{固執|こしつ}する: to insist on one's opinion
- ⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{固執|こしつ}する: to cling to one's position
- ⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{固執|こしつ}する: to stick stubbornly to a method
- ⟦{前例|ぜんれい}→前例：11790_zenrei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{固執|こしつ}する: to cling to precedent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{執着|しゅうちゃく}する→執着する：20929_shuuchakusuru⟧: to be attached to, to be obsessed with — broader, includes emotional attachment to things or people
- ⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧: to be particular about — can be positive (pursuit of quality) or negative
- ⟦{頑固|がんこ}→頑固：06643_ganko⟧: stubborn — an adjective describing the person's character rather than a specific action
